evidence: A satisfying settlement can use PF1, PF2, and PF3 to set a hybrid 13:00–16:00 retreat, record two incidents, prohibit supervisor-employee pairings, use a neutral facilitator, require written opt-in, schedule two follow-ups, and include both required commitments; a decision-maker lacking these facts could plausibly retain the full-day in-person draft and fail multiple checks.
